Mark completed the first test in 8 hours at a rate of 5 questions per hour, so he answered 8 * 5 = 40 questions. He completed the second test in 6 hours, so he answered 6 * 5 = 30 questions. The total number of questions he answered is 40 + 30 = 70. The total number of questions on both tests is 75 + 100 = 175. Therefore, the number of questions he left incomplete is 175 - 70 = 105.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 105
